prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: photorealistic intermediate frame for a website scroll-driven PC assembly sequence
Input images: Image 1 is the sole edit target and the exact visual anchor
Primary request: Create the stage immediately before cable installation. Keep the exact same black gaming PC case, three-quarter camera angle, lens, framing, silhouette, scale, black studio background, floor shadow, lighting, yellow accent color, and installed component positions as Image 1. The case must remain stationary and pixel-close to the edit target. Inside the open case, keep the motherboard, CPU with square liquid-cooler pump block, two yellow-lit RAM sticks, the rear cooling assembly with exactly two vertically stacked yellow-ring fans and its liquid-cooling hoses, and the same triple-fan GPU, all fully installed in their exact final sockets and positions. Remove the transparent side-glass panel completely so the case is visibly open. Remove only the visible electrical/power/data cable bundles and connectors, including the thick right-side motherboard cable bundle and lower-right GPU power bundle; leave cable-routing openings clean and empty. AIO coolant hoses are not electrical cables and must remain.
Style/medium: ultra-photorealistic premium PC product photography, physically plausible materials and component mounting
Composition/framing: portrait canvas matching Image 1 exactly; do not crop, rotate, zoom, shift, redesign, or alter perspective
Lighting/mood: identical dramatic black studio lighting with restrained yellow highlights
Constraints: change only side glass and visible electrical cables; preserve chassis geometry, front panel, feet, screws, vents, motherboard, CPU pump, RAM, two rear fans, AIO hoses, GPU, shadows, reflections outside the removed glass, and all component alignment; every installed part must sit naturally in its real mounting point; no floating parts; no extra parts; no text; no logo; no watermark
Avoid: exploded view, components laid over the case, duplicated parts, distorted hardware, transparent ghost parts, different case, different camera, added RGB colors, side glass reflection

provenance.conversion: ffmpeg libwebp, quality 94, compression_level 6, preset picture; no resize or crop
